beats.headline: She has her pick, and she uses it
beats.text: Subject is an outreach associate for the Borant Corporation and a member of the Bloom, the party that runs Borant, and party members are treated better as a matter of course. Brynhild's Daughters were hers, and Hekla with them, and the moment that account is lost she lodges a claim on the party that now has a former Daughter in it. The claim is not a strong one. She is Bloom, and the associate who holds the account is not.

beats.headline: The new arrangement
beats.text: Subject Loita takes over as the Royal Court's PR agent, with Zev kept on as social media manager. Zev, Loita says, has had a personal tragedy back home and has been sent to a temporary reeducation retreat, which never takes long on the weak-minded. Refreshments are over, on the grounds that some crawlers were getting illegal buffs from them. On air, Odette is muted mid-question about Eva, and off air again mid-sentence about Chris. Before the show, she tells Carl he does not scare her. Ditto, he says.

beats.headline: I am not Zev
beats.text: All three clients commanded very high fees; the cat's and the man's bidding wars ran to the final microsecond, and the cat's set a record. The cat, the man and the dinosaur are booked in six or seven days on a program about the cat's sponsor's product, which arrives as a benefactor box that is really a free sample. The man may make his famous comments, but should not disparage it too much. The man calls it an infomercial and asks whether she is kidding. She is not Zev, she reminds him, and that tone will not be tolerated. Zev is still in treatment.

beats.headline: The doll is rigged to blow
beats.text: The fourth robot cat has just exploded in front of the Spit and Swallow. Subject Loita informs Crawler Carl that the real Veriluxx toy takes far more stress, and that his boosted strength is the problem: it is built for children outside an enhancement zone. She adds that once the production realised he would fiddle with it, they required the sponsor to make the doll self-destruct if sufficiently broken, so that he could not get at the interior parts. The retail version will not have that feature. Try not to break the next one, she says.

beats.headline: Mongo, as a threat
beats.text: Subject Loita announces that Crawler Princess Donut has a new doll to spend time with, and that if it works the pair will do the show a day early. When the cat talks back, Loita tells her she keeps forgetting her place. When the cat says she smells, Loita says the feeling is mutual, and that if she talks back again Mongo will be taken from her and fed to a mob on the next floor while she watches. She refuses to send Zev down for a goodbye. At Bonnie's bedside, she tells the crawlers that audiences like drama, not melodrama.

beats.headline: The toy on the couch
beats.text: Subject Loita, outreach associate of the Borant Corporation and member of the Bloom, waits in a rented undersea trailer while the crawlers tape a toy commercial, Crawler Carl having left the cat doll beside her with orders to stay. She has just told them that their culture is a rot upon the Bloom, and that bringing Zev back into the fold took unspeakable things done to Zev's mother and aunts. The doll explodes. The trailer's shield holds the cracked window, and repair ships are on their way. Her last words: the Bloom will prevail. Crawler Carl tells her nobody likes melodrama.
